stage: F1 projected-neighbor head and D4 bounded arithmetic evidence

F1.projection: PLSRegression(n_components=8,scale=False,max_iter=500,tol=1e-6), fitted only on outer-fitting hard questions and valid candidate rows; x and y centered within valid candidates of each question
F1.export: float64 mean and rotations, used identically for fitting index and query; one shared projection/index per outer partition
F1.index: projected valid hard fitting candidates, binary final-correctness targets, and internal question membership for calibration only
F1.metric: Euclidean distance, weights1/max(distance,1e-3), stable distance sort, binary probability clipped[1e-4,1-1e-4] then logit
F1.calibration: Every fitting-side query excludes ALL index entries from its own question. Held-out scores use no exclusions and never fit the projection/index/scale.
F1.query_inputs: Provided embeddings and parsed validity only; candidate/question IDs never used as prediction features
F1.index_size: Report uncompressed asset bytes; must be<=16MiB per candidate head, ensemble totals checked only at later freeze

D4.source: question numeric/word-number mentions only; Fraction arithmetic; no reference, labels or candidate answers guide search
D4.initial_quantities: at most8 occurrences: all if<=8, otherwise first4+last4; occurrence masks prevent reusing one source quantity in an expression
D4.value_bounds: abs(value)<=1e9 and denominator<=1e6 for derived states
D4.search_order: deterministic coprime spread over operand pairs, deduplicate(value,source-mask); retain by operation count, constant use, source coverage, rational complexity
D4.equality: exact Fraction or1e-6relative/absolute tolerance for feature matching; official exact parser still controls evaluation
D4.interpretation: Incomplete arithmetic reachability; reached values need not solve the word problem, unreached values are not proved impossible
D4.cost_probe: First16 training questions, feature extraction only, no learner fit or model choice; report projected full cost as estimate, then process full training bank
D4.coverage: quantities truncated, state/attempt counts and caps, candidate reachability, feature ranges/nonzero/within-question variation

trees.sampling: only hard fitting questions and valid rows, sample weight4/validcandidatecount perquestion
trees.base: exact original75 features; matched+29expression features only

score_scale: std of all-four-centered scores on valid candidates from all outer-fitting questions, separately per model; neighbor fitting predictions leave own question out
aggregation: same-answer group mean, zero consensus bonus
adaptation: No parameter/feature expansion after observing results. Repairs preserved explicitly. No validation/test/fullrefit/deployment in this stage.
interpretation: Repeated questions across two fold seeds are not independent new samples; this is conditional exploratory research following previous study selection.
